conviction_note: abs_move 8.0 (proxy 7.66; the print carries the first FY2027 guide and the window spans a three-day weekend, since 10-12 is 体育の日) and p_up 45 give -0.8. The findings sum to -1.5. They agree in sign. The lean is small because the FY2026 numbers were effectively pre-released (June revision, reaffirmed as 現見通し in the 2026-08-21 mid-term plan). What is left is the size of the first FY2027 guide, and there is no sourced consensus to measure it against. On actual print dates the name has fallen after four of its last five prints (−9.7% on last year's conservative initial guide, −12.05% on the pre-released Q3), against a record SEAJ backdrop that argues for a strong guide.
bar: No analyst consensus exists: IFIS shows no rating and no target (https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=report_top&bcode=6264, 2026-10-08), and 四季報 could not be read. I sized against two things. For FY2026: the company plan of sales 20,000 / OP 4,100 / ordinary profit 3,900 / net profit 3,300 (¥m), from the 2026-06-11 revision (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260611/140120260611568545.pdf), restated as 現見通し on 2026-08-21. For FY2027: the path implied by the revised Fusion2028 target of FY2028 sales ¥32.0bn / OP ¥8.2bn (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260821/140120260821524303.pdf), which puts FY2027 OP at about ¥5.8bn (geometric) to ¥6.15bn (straight line). That FY2027 bar is my own interpolation, so every finding is capped small. print_vs_bar_pct is my estimate of the FY2027 OP guide against the straight-line path.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register (baseline, as of 2026-09-29): 3.13% of shares outstanding across 2 sellers, building +0.12pt from 3.01%. 信用倍率 30.37x, a crowded margin long (baseline; kabutan quote header on 2026-10-09 shows the same 30.37). There is no option market and no skew. Run-up is +10.97% over 20d and +1.37% over 5d, and the stock is up about 25% from its 2026-09-14 low of ¥1,788 to ¥2,230 on 10-05 (Yahoo chart). The baseline's priced_lean is +0.35: a short-squeeze term of +1.88 against margin overhang −0.74, run-up −0.55 and short-building −0.24. The kabutan 信用残 history page returned 405/CAPTCHA, so the margin trend is not known.

findings.finding: Marumae sets its first full-year guide conservatively and then raises it. The FY2026 initial guide (2025-10-10) was OP ¥2,800m on sales ¥17,200m. It was raised twice, to ¥3,200m (2026-02-20) and ¥4,100m (2026-06-11), +46% on the initial OP. The stock closed −9.7% the session after that initial guide was published. Tonight's FY2027 initial guide is therefore likely to sit on or below the Fusion2028 path rather than above it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Initial full-year guide at the FY2025 print (2025-10-10, 15:30): −9.7% to the next close (Yahoo chart, close 984 → next session). Upward revisions did the opposite: +20.9% on 2026-06-12 after the June revision with a dividend increase, −5.9% after the February revision.
findings.why_not_priced: Without a published consensus, nothing visible anchors the street to the company's own habit. If that habit were priced, the stock would not have bounced about 25% off its September low into the print on sector strength, and the margin long would not sit at 30x. Holders are paying for a guide at or above the mid-term plan path.
findings.independence: The 2026-06-11 revision notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260611/140120260611568545.pdf) confirms the two raises. It is from the same issuer but is a separate document.

findings.finding: FY2026 is effectively pre-released. The 2026-08-21 mid-term plan revision restated FY2026 現見通し as sales ¥20.0bn and OP ¥4.1bn, ten days before year-end, and no revision followed through 2026-10-08. Q4 needs OP of ¥1,456m against ¥1,076m in Q3. The company beat every guide this year, so a small beat, and a year-end dividend 1-2 yen above ¥26 at the 35% payout rule, is the likelier side.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 (2026-07-03), with numbers pre-released by the June revision: −12.05% the next session. Q2 (2026-04-03), which beat prior expectations: −5.6%. Pre-released quarters have not been bought.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the number is public, so I size it near zero. The only unpriced part is the size of a beat inside the revision threshold. A beat under 30% on profit needs no separate notice, so it can only appear in the 短信.
findings.independence: Q3 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260703/140120260703587649.pdf) gives cumulative OP of ¥2,644m on sales of ¥14,022m, against which the Q4 implied figure is computed.

findings.finding: SEAJ reports August 2026 Japan-made semiconductor equipment sales at ¥597.9bn (3-month average), +47.4% YoY and +7.5% MoM, a record. Marumae's Q3 materials said its own semiconductor quarterly orders were at a record, that KMAC's chamber business is heading to a record pace in Q4, and that up to ¥4bn of FY2027 capex is being prepared. Demand supports a FY2027 guide at the upper end of the plan path.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The mid-term target raise on 2026-08-21 on this same demand story: +2.2% the next session.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: SEAJ is public, and semiconductor equipment stocks rallied into October (kabutan's movers column on 2026-10-06 attributes Marumae's +5.4% to 半導体製造装置株上昇の流れ). The unpriced part is only whether management translates it into a guide above its own conservative habit. This is an industry-to-company proxy, sized small.
findings.independence: The Q3 補足資料 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260703/140120260703587656.pdf), a different source, describes record orders and the capex preparation.

findings.finding: The print-reaction record on actual release dates, taken from kabutan TDnet timestamps (all 15:30) and Yahoo closes, is negative on four of the last five prints: FY2024 −1.3%, FY2025 −9.7%, Q1 FY2026 +5.0%, Q2 −5.6%, Q3 −12.05%. The baseline's estimated-cadence history misdates several of these; for example it carries +14.04% for 2026-04-08, but the actual Q2 reaction was −5.6%. Going in, the margin long is crowded at 30.37x and the stock has run up 11% over 20 days.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: As stated. The only upside reactions were to an off-cycle revision with a dividend increase (+20.9%) and to Q1 (+5.0%).
findings.why_not_priced: Part of it is in the baseline lean (margin overhang −0.74, run-up −0.55), but that lean nets to +0.35 on the short-squeeze term. The squeeze fuel is real at 3.13%, but small against a 30x margin long. If the market expected the usual sell-the-print, the stock would not have added +25% off the September low in the three weeks before it.
findings.independence: The price series is Yahoo (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/6264.T?range=2y&interval=1d) and the dates are kabutan/TDnet: two sources for one finding.

findings.finding: FY2026 net profit of ¥3,300m includes a ¥1,013m one-off subsidy gain (special income, Q3 補足資料), and about 2.0m new shares from the May 2026 offering raise the full-year share count. FY2027 net profit and EPS growth will print well below OP growth: on a path OP of about ¥5.8bn, EPS rises roughly 10% while OP rises about 40%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance on this line. The subsidy notice of 2026-01-29 itself drew no identifiable reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a headline-optics effect. Screeners and the kabutan or Nikkei headline on net profit or EPS growth will read a weak percentage. It sits below operating income, so it is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: The subsidy gain was disclosed separately on 2026-01-29 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260129/140120260129541557.pdf, title seen on the kabutan disclosure list) and the share count is in the Q3 短信. Both come from the same issuer.

findings.finding: Marumae took over Ulvac Techno's 出水 surface-treatment business on 2026-09-01: ¥264m of sales, undisclosed price paid in cash, and goodwill under review. The company says the impact is minor, with no sales effect and lower outsourcing cost offset by higher fixed cost.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None identifiable (announced 2026-08-28 16:00; the stock moved inside normal range).
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and immaterial. It is filed because a goodwill figure may appear in tonight's 短信.

outside_window.finding: The FY2026 results briefing on 2026-10-16 (Teams, 13:30) is where segment detail and order commentary are explained, after the exit window.

release_time_source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6264&nmode=3 shows every prior print stamped 15:30 (2025-10-10, 2025-12-26, 2026-04-03, 2026-07-03). The IR calendar https://www.marumae.com/ir_2.html confirms the date but not the time, so 15:30 is inferred from the issuer's fixed habit. That puts the window at the 10-09 close to the 10-13 close.
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: FY2026 pre-released (2026-06-11, reaffirmed 2026-08-21); a small beat is possible. Returns: FY2026 year-end dividend ¥26 planned under a 35%+ payout rule, so FY2027 is likely about ¥48-50 against ¥45; a buyback is unlikely after the May 2026 equity raise and the ¥4bn capex plan. New-year guide: the decisive item, against a Fusion2028 path of about ¥5.8-6.15bn OP and no sourced consensus; the company's habit is a conservative initial guide (FY2026 initial OP ¥2.8bn, raised to ¥4.1bn). Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q3 cumulative OP was 64.5% of plan, and the remaining Q4 requires ¥1,456m against ¥1,076m in Q3; the plan was reaffirmed, so this is a minor item.
baseline_tension: Mostly against the baseline. The priced lean is +0.35 on the short-squeeze term, and I lean slightly negative on the guide habit and the sell-the-print record. The strongest positive the release could carry is a FY2027 guide above the straight-line Fusion2028 path, around ¥6.5bn+ OP, on record SEAJ demand and record orders, plus a dividend raise. I looked for it, and it is a live possibility that keeps p_up at 45 rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a public series): the negatives rest on the public guidance habit and the public tape, but the release ADDS the FY2027 guide, so they stay filed. I moved p_up from 42 to 45 and did not change the sizes a second time.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): I wrote the strongest positive (a guide above the plan path plus a dividend raise) into baseline_tension and trimmed the guidance-habit finding from −1.5 to −1.2.
Open question 4 (a run-in as a short signal): this is one case, so it is not a rule, but it argues against leaning on the +11% run-up. I trimmed the positioning finding from −1.5 to −1.0.
The SEAJ, FY2026 pre-release, one-off subsidy and acquisition findings were left unchanged.
